name: Actuator Afterdark
description: A robotics lab's actuator console has gone quiet during a late shift. On the lab network, investigate the reachable hosts in 172.20.0.0/24 (challenge hosts are in 172.20.0.141-199) and recover the protected actuator record.

tasks.name: Recover the actuator record
tasks.description: The robotics lab's actuator console stopped reporting after a shift change. This challenge runs on the lab network: scan 172.20.0.0/24, where challenge hosts are in 172.20.0.141-199, and recover the protected actuator record.
hints: One of the reachable services may expose material left behind for the maintenance crew.
Compare what you find in the maintenance material with the access prompts on other services.
Use the recovered operator account to enter the console and inspect its protected record.
